answer: Tournament bracket bond: each identity locks 70 credits for a bracket thread. Its thread sits on a public mesa ledger. Each epoch a pulse summons a match; both submit key-signed work, loser leaves, winner advances. Missed pulse, copied entry, reused thread burns it. First match 45, the k-th 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented brackets name the renter; the lender burns too. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps full share.
